conditional_negative_bound.excludes: SDK latency, ECS visibility, startup, model runtime, retries and cleanup; not a measured production speedup

limitations: No per-stage production duration can be recovered from absent telemetry labels or pre-completion report counters.
Exact saved task frames are still needed to attribute worker.ai/native/privesc/publish; content may be inside collector work.
Invocation timings include workspace construction, task startup, model execution, validation and cleanup; they do not isolate model inference.
Existing task frames must be validated with the stage roster matching their deployed source; the added labels require integration before they can appear.
Nested and concurrent wall totals overlap; do not sum them into workflow wall time.
source_findings: worker.ai aggregates the sequential Network and Priorities work; old stage labels do not split the two.
Priorities receives validated Network findings through with_findings and network_review; concurrent invocation would change its exact inputs.
The report runtime.analyzer=0 is from pre-completion publication, not actual duration.
The hosted task checks agent exit as well as task exit; it already avoids waiting for relay teardown.

The hosted poll sleeps at most two seconds per iteration. Removing only terminal detection sleep saves at most two seconds per successful invocation, conditional on identical API latency, state visibility and completion time.
